capabilities: Log sleep with a single wake-up tap
Record habit counts with one-tap buttons
Review day, week and month comparisons
Store records as plain Markdown lines
Edit times, notes and deletions per entry
disambiguation: Not a medical health-record keeper; it only logs sleep and habit counters as timestamped Markdown lines.
extras: Known limits: no reminders or goals, one sleep per night, custom types are counters only; data.json stores settings while records live in Markdown files.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in sleep or habit log, so capturing daily counts and comparing them over time needs external apps or manual bookkeeping.
summary: Sidebar sleep and habit logger that writes one-line Markdown records and reviews them with day, week and month comparisons, fully offline.
